ui.setup.heading: Before we start
ui.setup.note_p1: Everything happens on this computer. When you speak, your words are turned into text here, by a speech model stored with this program — the recording is never sent anywhere. Your answers are saved in this browser only, and nothing is sent to any company or server.
ui.setup.note_p2: If you choose a PIN below, your answers are saved in this browser, encrypted with it, so you can stop and come back. Your Social Security number and bank numbers are never saved: if you stop partway, you will be asked for them again. Use this on a device you trust and do not use it on a shared or public computer. You can say skip at any sensitive question and fill it in by hand later.
ui.setup.note_p3: The first question asks which form you are filling out. This tool fills in the forms for you to review, sign, and send yourself. It does not send anything to the Social Security Administration or to Maine's Department of Health and Human Services.
